snippet.title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Seafarer: The Ship Sim is coming to PlayStation 5 on September 24, 2026 - Pre-order now!

Take the helm solo or with a crew of up to four players, command a diverse fleet, and complete cargo, rescue, firefighting, and patrol missions across a vast open world.

MASTER THE OPEN SEA.

#ps5 #ps5games #seafarertheshipsim  #ShipSimulator #SimulationGame
